summary: Core provenance, normalization, artifact counts and oracle invocation supported within bounded verification; source coverage, safety receipt semantics, CPU timing, and exactly-once claim boundaries require explicit qualifiers.

A.name: ground_truth_provenance
A.details: Labels derive from restored simulator keep/replan branches and raw endpoint truth, not trained model predictions; simulation only.

B.name: score_normalization
B.details: Shared obligation task priorities supply the normalization denominator. Completed tasks receive zero residual penalty. Measured CPU introduces timing variation and is not a physical benefit.

C.name: result_existence_and_numbers
C.details: 168 unique committed identities match frozen registry, 14 cells each contain 12, marker hashes/current bindings and shard presence match. Derived report counts agree. One raw formal shard fully hash-verified and one positive label recomputed. This reviewer did not repeat all 168 compressed/raw data checks or all 834 pair-cost computations.

D.name: independent_oracle_called
D.details: Generation and analysis call oracle validation/recomputation. Oracle implements cost checks separately from the production scorer. Independence is implementation independence, not a separate physical simulator or external validation.

E.name: scope_and_claims
E.details: All 417 ordinary valid states and all 12 ordinary valid selected-cross states come from the 56 Periodic-4min scenarios; no learned gate/WM/PPO/test/OOD efficacy established. 343 unresolved dispositions all reflect pre-public hash mismatch, not established physical violations. Positive state labels and NOOP-positive suffixes must not be conflated. Exactly-once proof is limited to directed fixtures and post-discovery pairs.

F.name: evaluation_type
F.details: Synthetic simulator paired-label collection plus engineering protocol fixtures; not real GT, human evaluation, deployed policy effectiveness, or real-disaster external validity.

training_gate.denominator: Unique valid ordinary states pooled over train+validation; positive>=30, nonpositive>=30; each class covers >1 scenario within each split.

safety_receipts.interpretation: Receipt verification unknown because pre-public hashes disagree; not proof of 343 physical violations or complete safety.

positive_labels.noop_positive_suffix_interpretation: Identical J_exec; CPU timing differences outweigh one additional 0.05 call charge.

selected_cross_subset.claim_boundary: Descriptive paired selected-action subset, not local-vs-cross causal effect.

frozen_binding.scope: package/civilian/*.py, configs/*.json, BASELINE_PROVENANCE.json; excludes analysis/tests/focused helpers.
frozen_binding.cost_config_limit: Oracle compares the two pair-carried configs, not external frozen config; sampled values match current defaults.

exactly_once.not_covered: New split/cooperate and discovery chain occurring inside the paired rollout; performance gain or exhaustive safety.

claims.qualification: Current marker identities/bindings and file presence independently verified; all raw checks not rerun by this reviewer.
3 positive unique ordinary states total; training gate false.

claims.qualification: 12 Periodic-4min states/scenarios, 24 suffixes, frozen synthetic costs; descriptive, not local-vs-cross causal comparison.

claims.qualification: Three positive NOOP suffixes are separate, with negative parent-state means and equal J_exec.

claims.claim: 343 unresolved receipts prove physical safety violations or complete safety
claims.qualification: All 343 are pre-public hash verification unknowns.

claims.claim: Directed split/cooperate discovery is exactly-once and revealed rescue enters later pair obligations
claims.qualification: Two modified fixtures, pair snapshots at t=24 after discovery, NOOP replan.

claims.claim: Paired rollout itself verifies new split/cooperate-to-discovery exactly-once chain
Existing-ET is proven superior to other strategies
claims.qualification: May be retained as an existing baseline by decision, without comparative efficacy claim.

claims.claim: Learned gate, WM, PPO or real-disaster generalization effective
claims.qualification: These method efficacy evaluations were not performed.

verification_scope.persistence_turn_operations: File persistence and SHA-256 calculation only; no tests or simulations.

required_report_corrections: State explicitly that all 417 valid ordinary labels and 12 valid selected-cross states come from Periodic-4min across 56 scenarios.
Describe all 343 unresolved main-trajectory dispositions as pre-public hash verification unknowns, without converting them to physical violation counts.
Separate the three positive local insert state means from the three positive NOOP suffix values whose state means remain negative.
Qualify executed selected-cross action coverage as insert/direct-dispatch; do not imply selected transfer/split/cooperate evidence.
Replace stale wording that 30/30 remains to be checked with the already-established gate-not-met result.
Preserve the post-discovery NOOP-pair boundary on focused exactly-once evidence.
Describe frozen hash coverage precisely and retain separate hashes for post-processing/report inputs.
hash_capture_note: SHA-256 values captured while persisting the completed review. They identify file bytes at persistence time, not a retroactive independently timestamped archive of bytes at the beginning of review. Subsequent edits require a new hash/review scope.
